'''Gorik''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Stationed on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] around [[3643 BBY]], he at one point requested an audience with [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Merile Yurrion]]. Gorik employed [[Havoc Squad]] defector [[Vanto Bazren]] and a [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] named [[Kyvax]] to build bomb-filled [[Droid/Legends|droids]] to be tested in the city of [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]]. When the reformed Havoc Squad showed up to take him down, Gorik managed to escape.
